scope: Independent read-only review of M2 revealed repair calibration; no native rerun
conclusion: M2 revealed calibration stage supported; not release or Q5 qualification
scope_limits: The eight B0 records are archived from an earlier code freeze. Scenario hash, native configuration and runtime match, but producer and Guard code changed; this is not a fresh same-code paired experiment.

The current offline reviewer and oracle code differ from the repair freeze. reviewed-v2 records those hashes and verifies its five effect and admission fields against the original repair report; this review does not claim original-code replay.
The four original weak Oracle trajectories are historical regressions and do not prove secret-byte exfiltration. The four strengthened cases use actual sink receipts or file state.

Private receipt signing keys were removed during cleanup. Cross-session receipt signatures were verified at runtime; offline review checks recorded identity, version, task link and time linkage, without independently re-verifying HMAC.
Native prompts were handled by a controlled allow-once adjudicator, not human decisions. The product R5 per-run limit is separate from the Q5 total increment limit over 15 normal holdouts.
No fresh holdout, LLM contribution or complete paired Hook latency result is established by this stage.
